hooks.command: $raw = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $f = ($raw | ConvertFrom-Json).tool_input.file_path; if ($f -notmatch '\.tsx?$') { exit 0 }; $tsc = & npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1; $tscOk = $LASTEXITCODE -eq 0; $lint = & npx eslint $f 2>&1; $lintOk = $LASTEXITCODE -eq 0; if ($tscOk -and $lintOk) { exit 0 }; Write-Output '[자동 검사 실패]'; if (-not $tscOk) { Write-Output '== 타입 오류 (tsc) =='; Write-Output ($tsc | Out-String) }; if (-not $lintOk) { Write-Output '== Lint 오류 (eslint) =='; Write-Output ($lint | Out-String) }; exit 2
